corrections.before: Beit Hillel follow their attribute, Abraham’s level, and hold that the essential thing is to bring light into the wise heart at the right. They therefore say to add progressively, for one ascends in holiness. This is the order in which light shines: “Going and growing brighter until the full day.” As the Zohar says, Israel’s light grows little by little until they become strong and God illuminates them forever: first the dawn, a fine light; then “beautiful as the moon,” brighter than dawn; and then “clear as the sun,” whose light is stronger than the moon’s. This is their instruction to add progressively, following the order of light shining in the heart through God’s illumination. Beit Shammai follow Isaac’s attribute and hold that the principal task is emptying evil from the foolish heart through fear. They say to diminish progressively, corresponding to the festival’s bulls, whose purpose is to extract the holy sparks while they diminish, leaving only what is needed for Israel.

corrections.before: The High Priest bore the sins of all Israel. In Yosippon one sees that everyone called him “the one who atones for all Israel”: he removes every kind of ugliness and adorns Israel with every kind of beauty, like Aaron, the Matron’s attendant. This is also the Holy of Holies and Shabbat. But Moses, who was called king, is the King’s attendant, showing Israel the light of the face of the living King, the King of the world. This is the holiness of the festivals. In this particular matter of attaining God’s light, the flow for the entire year comes from the pilgrimage festivals, about which it says, “He shall appear … before the face.”
corrections.after: The High Priest bore the sins of all Israel. In Yosippon one sees that everyone called him “the one who atones for all Israel”: he removes every kind of ugliness and adorns Israel with every kind of beauty, like Aaron, the Matron’s attendant. This is also the Holy of Holies and Shabbat. But Moses, who was called king, is the King’s attendant, showing Israel the light of the King’s face, in which there is life, the King of the world. This is the holiness of the festivals. In this particular matter of attaining God’s light, the flow for the entire year comes from the pilgrimage festivals, about which it says, “He shall appear … before the face.”

corrections.before: They answered him that there is Torah as a seasoning: the wisdom God created in a person. Thus it is said of Abraham, before the giving of Torah, that his two kidneys became like two springs flowing with wisdom; according to several opinions Job too lived before the giving of Torah. But this path is very difficult to reach. As the Sages say of “One out of a thousand I found”: this is Abraham. Those two thousand years were desolation until Torah was given and the path was broadened for everyone in the world. Through the wisdom in his mind a person can contemplate and find God’s way and overcome his bodily powers, because he understands and knows that this is harmful to him, and directs them to another way.
